vulnerability_analysis: The contract has a function clearStuckBalance_sender(uint256 amountPercentage) that allows authorized users to drain BNB from the contract. With amountPercentage = 100, it transfers 100% of contract's BNB balance to the caller. The function is protected by the 'authorized' modifier, which requires the caller to be in the authorizations mapping (set by the owner).
attack_strategy: Impersonate the contract owner (or an authorized address) and call clearStuckBalance_sender(100) to drain all BNB from the contract to our address.
step_by_step_plan: 1. Identify the contract owner address. 2. Use vm.prank() to impersonate the owner. 3. Ensure the contract has BNB balance by sending some BNB to it. 4. Call clearStuckBalance_sender(100) to drain all BNB. 5. Verify our balance increased.
